_about: Token counts of one video-lesson build, for server/lesson/build_cost_estimate.py. Sized from the real prompts (about 4 characters per token) and a 20-minute tutorial; edit the numbers to model another lesson. Every call: system (the fixed prompt, same across builds), shared (the part of the user message that is the same for every call of one build or one video: the transcript, the lesson outline and fixed rules), own (what changes per call), output.

coach_session._about: One learner session after the build: calls that share the lesson context (system + lesson JSON) within the cache TTL
